```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Rostered seasons from 2019 (the first class-year season) through the last
# complete season; the season still being played is left out.
complete_through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
usage <- targets::tar_read(player_usage, store = file.path(root, "_targets"))
by_pos <- stat_line_share(usage, seasons = 2019:complete_through) |>
  filter(position_group %in% names(position_palette()))

p <- by_pos |>
  mutate(
    tip = paste0(
      position_group,
      ": ",
      scales::percent(any_line, accuracy = 1),
      " of ",
      fmt(player_seasons),
      " player-seasons logged a line"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(any_line, reorder(position_group, any_line), fill = position_group)) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = position_palette(), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Which positions show up in the box score?",
    subtitle = "Share of rostered player-seasons with a stat line in at least one game",
    x = "Share with a stat line",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "stat-line-share-by-position", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-season-figure
# The same share season by season, to see whether a group moves or holds.
by_season <- rostered_one_team(usage, seasons = 2019:complete_through) |>
  filter(position_group %in% names(position_palette())) |>
  group_by(position_group, season) |>
  summarise(any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    tip = paste0(
      position_group,
      ", ",
      season,
      ": ",
      scales::percent(any_line, accuracy = 1),
      " of ",
      fmt(n),
      " logged a line"
    )
  )

p_season <- ggplot(
  by_season,
  aes(season, any_line, colour = position_group, group = position_group)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip), size = 3) +
  scale_colour_position(guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Does the share hold season to season?",
    subtitle = "Share of rostered player-seasons with a stat line in at least one game, by season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Share with a stat line",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_season)
```

```{r}
#| label: position-table
by_pos |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = as.character(position_group),
    `Player-seasons` = fmt(player_seasons),
    `Logged a stat line in any game` = scales::percent(any_line, accuracy = 0.1),
    `Median share of games, among those who logged one` = scales::percent(median_share_if_any, accuracy = 1)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(`Logged a stat line in any game`)) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Position group",
      "Player-seasons",
      "Logged a stat line in any game",
      "Median share of games, among those who logged one"
    ),
    align = "lrrr",
    caption = paste0(
      "Rostered player-seasons from 2019 through the season ",
      complete_through,
      ". Athlete and unrecorded positions are left out of the comparison."
    )
  )
```
